newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican union boss rushed to hospital -- TV.
newsitem.headline: Mexican union boss rushed to hospital -- TV.

text.p: All-powerful veteran union boss Fidel Velazquez has been rushed to hospital after suffering pains in his arms and stomach, the Televisa news network reported Wednesday.
Velazquez, the 96-year-old boss of the Confederation of Mexican Workers (CTM), has lined up organised labour in support of the government for more than half a century.
Televisa said Velazquez had been taken to the ABC hospital in Mexico City for checks. The television report showed footage of him at his last news conference Monday, looking frail and unwell.
